question: Among users who have received at least one badge and have a reputation greater than 1000, consider their posts created in 2010 or 2011. For each year–user combination, compute the percentage of posts that satisfy all of the following conditions: the post has an above-average view count, its title contains either “probability” or “distribution”, it has at least 2 comments, and it has a favorite count of at least 3. Sort these year–user combinations by this percentage in descending order, select the top two, and for each row return only the year and the user’s display name (DisplayName).

prediction.sql:
WITH eligible_users AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT u.XCL_052 AS user_id
    FROM users u
    INNER JOIN badges b ON u.XCL_052 = b.XCL_002
    WHERE u.XCL_053 > 1000
),
base_posts AS (
    SELECT 
        p.XCL_026 AS post_id,
        p.XCL_033 AS user_id,
        strftime('%Y', p.XCL_029) AS post_year,
        p.XCL_030 AS view_count,
        p.XCL_035 AS title,
        p.XCL_038 AS comment_count,
        p.XCL_039 AS favorite_count
    FROM posts p
    INNER JOIN eligible_users eu ON p.XCL_033 = eu.user_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', p.XCL_029) IN ('2010', '2011')
),
avg_view AS (
    SELECT AVG(view_count) AS avg_views FROM base_posts
),
flagged_posts AS (
    SELECT 
        bp.post_year,
        bp.user_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN bp.view_count > av.avg_views 
             AND (bp.title LIKE '%probability%' OR bp.title LIKE '%distribution%')
             AND bp.comment_count >= 2 
             AND bp.favorite_count >= 3 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END AS is_qualifying
    FROM base_posts bp
    CROSS JOIN avg_view av
),
year_user_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        post_year,
        user_id,
        CAST(SUM(is_qualifying) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
    FROM flagged_posts
    GROUP BY post_year, user_id
)
SELECT 
    yus.post_year AS year,
    u.XCL_055 AS DisplayName
FROM year_user_stats yus
INNER JOIN users u ON yus.user_id = u.XCL_052
ORDER BY yus.percentage DESC
LIMIT 2

WITH eligible_users AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT u.XCL_052 AS user_id
    FROM users u
    INNER JOIN badges b ON u.XCL_052 = b.XCL_002
    WHERE u.XCL_053 > 1000
),
base_posts AS (
    SELECT 
        p.XCL_026 AS post_id,
        p.XCL_033 AS user_id,
        strftime('%Y', p.XCL_029) AS post_year,
        p.XCL_030 AS view_count,
        p.XCL_035 AS title,
        p.XCL_038 AS comment_count,
        p.XCL_039 AS favorite_count
    FROM posts p
    INNER JOIN eligible_users eu ON p.XCL_033 = eu.user_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', p.XCL_029) IN ('2010', '2011')
),
avg_view AS (
    SELECT AVG(view_count) AS avg_views FROM base_posts
),
flagged_posts AS (
    SELECT 
        bp.post_year,
        bp.user_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN bp.view_count > av.avg_views 
             AND (bp.title LIKE '%probability%' OR bp.title LIKE '%distribution%')
             AND bp.comment_count >= 2 
             AND bp.favorite_count >= 3 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END AS is_qualifying
    FROM base_posts bp
    CROSS JOIN avg_view av
),
year_user_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        post_year,
        user_id,
        CAST(SUM(is_qualifying) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
    FROM flagged_posts
    GROUP BY post_year, user_id
)
SELECT 
    yus.post_year AS year,
    u.XCL_055 AS DisplayName
FROM year_user_stats yus
INNER JOIN users u ON yus.user_id = u.XCL_052
ORDER BY yus.percentage DESC
LIMIT 2

WITH base AS (
  SELECT p.XCL_026 AS pid,
         p.XCL_033 AS uid,
         strftime('%Y', p.XCL_029) AS yr,
         p.XCL_031 AS views,
         p.XCL_035 AS title,
         p.XCL_038 AS fav,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.XCL_006 = p.XCL_026) AS ccount
  FROM posts p
  WHERE p.XCL_033 IN (SELECT DISTINCT b.XCL_002 FROM badges b)
    AND p.XCL_033 IN (SELECT XCL_052 FROM users WHERE XCL_053 > 1000)
    AND strftime('%Y', p.XCL_029) IN ('2010','2011')
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT yr, uid,
         CASE WHEN views > (SELECT AVG(views) FROM base)
              AND (title LIKE '%probability%' OR title LIKE '%distribution%')
              AND ccount >= 2 AND fav >= 3
              THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ok
  FROM base
)
SELECT f.yr, u.XCL_055 AS DisplayName
FROM flagged f
JOIN users u ON u.XCL_052 = f.uid
GROUP BY f.yr, f.uid
ORDER BY 100.0 * SUM(f.ok) / COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 2;
